claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Anastrozole is a potent and specific aromatase inhibitor with no meaningful cytotoxic activity at 2.5 uM; it does not kill cancer cell lines directly, so any antiproliferative effect in a 5-day pooled viability screen would be minimal and not attributable to a cytotoxic mechanism class.
